title.en: Card A-1b: NP5-01a source-level per-site comparison for the mass_solve solve half (36 sites) plus an append-only addendum recording the 4 A-1a rulings (zero GPU)

intent.zh: 按 Chief 2026-11-11 18:00 指令与 4 条 A-1a 裁定：落 docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1b/（36 站点 source 级类型映射 + 表达式分类（六类词表）+ 双侧 file:line；pending=0；自检 76 总计数），并在 docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1a/ 追加 append-only addenda.md 记录 Chief 4 条裁定（engine-semantic 认可并补句；pin-needed 认可、标记真实精度偏离候选、进 NP5-04 deferred 清单、本片不修；tile 2 站点改 provisional pending-a1、由 RE-1 用 A1-final PTX 覆盖出最终分类；identical 前提补「收缩许可、未证位级相等」），不重写 A-1a evidence.json 字节。A-1b 覆盖：rigid solve 类 5 + resident_mass_substitute 4 + mixed_solve_validate/fused 9 + sparse_solve_validate/fused 8 + resident_sparse_validate/gather 4 + resident_mixed_validate/gather 4 + rounding-note 1/4 2。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/scripts/判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Per Chief's instruction and the 4 A-1a rulings: land np5-01a-a1b/ (36 sites, source-level type mapping + six-category expression classification + bilateral file:line; pending=0; 76 total self-check) and append an addendum in np5-01a-a1a/ recording the 4 rulings without rewriting the A-1a evidence bytes: engine-semantic accepted with the added clause; pin-needed accepted as a real precision-deviation candidate for the NP5-04 deferred list, not fixed here; the 2 tile sites become provisional pending-a1 to be finalized in RE-1 with A1-final PTX; the identical premise gains 'contraction-permitted, bit equality not proven'. Zero GPU/window; no src/tests/fixtures/scripts or criteria changes.

acceptance: `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1b/evidence.json`：36 站点（与 `A-1-split.json` A-1b 列表逐 id 一致；A-1a 40 + A-1b 36 = 76 自检），每站点含 id/kind/label/product_anchor(file:line)/reference_anchor(file:line 或显式 no-reference-entry)/type_mapping/classification/五项必填字段。

分类只用六类词表；`recipe-difference` 带 `value_equivalent: true` + `value_equivalence_basis: "analytic, not bit-tested"`；`not-decidable` 带 6 类 `not_decidable_reasons[]` + 缺证；`n/a` 带 why；`pin-needed` 带 pin_spec/expected；不写覆盖率/通过率。

`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1a/addenda.md`（append-only 新文件）：逐条记录 Chief 4 条裁定（R1 engine-semantic 补句；R2 pin-needed 真实精度偏离候选 + NP5-04 deferred 清单 + 本片不修；R3 2 站点 provisional pending-a1、RE-1 用 A1-final 出最终分类；R4 identical 前提补「收缩许可、未证位级相等」），并声明不重写 A-1a evidence.json；A-1a manifest 重算并列入本文件。
`README.md`：范围/方法/分类判据/逐组统计（无通过率）/A-1a 裁定落点/RE-1 交接（tile 2 站点 + A1-final 6 族）/非声明。
`receipt.json`：sites_total=36、pending_manual=0、分类计数、a1a_rulings_recorded=true、inputs（场表/spec/vocab/split sha）、tree.head、gates；`manifest.txt` 逐条 sha256+bytes 自核；UTF-8/LF/无 BOM。
`logs/selfcheck.txt`：36 站点/A-1a+A-1b=76/词表合法/理由码合法/必填字段齐全/无未加否定通过类表述 → PASS。

边界：写域仅 `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1b/**` + `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1a/addenda.md` + `np5-01a-a1a/manifest.txt`（派生重算）+ `.normify/**`；`unchanged src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`、`scripts/`；零 GPU、零窗。
四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit + `normify check`；中文提交。
note: Chief 2026-11-11 18:00 队列第 3 片 + 4 条 A-1a 裁定（写入 append-only addendum）；QA 可只读核；下一片 RE-1 按 A1-final 覆盖 tile 2 站点。
